claim_boundary: Source-pinned uniform-cost scheduling projection, not a measured prefix distribution, verifier benchmark, or deployment result.

model.affinity_batch_time_formula: ceil(groups * k / verifier_slots) * (p + ceil(n / k) * (1 - p))
assumptions: every complete attempt has equal normalized cost
every group has one exact shared prefix with CPU fraction p
k replicas split each group's unchanged attempts as evenly as possible
one affinity replica occupies one verifier slot and executes its unchanged suffixes serially
independent attempts and affinity replicas are work-conserving within whole waves
dispatch, trie, snapshot, and attribution overhead are zero unless an explicit sensitivity says otherwise

oprover_32b_default_eight_nodes.ineligibility_reason: The pinned default has four attempts per group; SHRED requires at least eight. This topology is sensitivity analysis only and cannot authorize execution or a claim.

scientific_finding: For the pinned eligible OProver-8B default, independent verification already exceeds available verifier slots. Theorem-affinity local tries can therefore reduce both verifier CPU and idealized batch latency. Two replicas are the strongest balanced point under the 80% shared-prefix hypothesis: 2.50x CPU throughput and 1.875x batch-latency improvement, with 13.33% of one independent verification per reuse in joint 2x-CPU/1.5x-latency overhead headroom. The joint target needs only a 66.67% shared prefix at zero overhead or 68.67% at 2% overhead. At 80% prefix plus 2% overhead, 38 of 44 eligible groups suffice; six complete group fallbacks remain charged while the batch projects 2.021x CPU and 1.807x latency. At a 70% prefix plus 2% overhead, all groups must qualify and the projection is 2.041x CPU and 1.531x latency. Three replicas improve idealized latency further but their 2.00x CPU figure has zero overhead margin.
decision: Advance only OProver-8B to the existing-run trace gate. Use two replicas as the preregistered balanced candidate and require its authentic conservative shared-prefix fraction to clear 2/3 plus registered normalized reuse overhead while the unequal-cost schedule preserves both targets. Retain one replica for a CPU-maximizing objective and three only for an explicitly latency-weighted objective. Prefer replication-aware theorem-affinity process-local execution over portable checkpoints if the authentic trace passes. Retain OProver-32B only as unsupported topology sensitivity unless a normal future configuration independently produces at least eight attempts per group.
